description: This header file declares internal API functions for the Slap Dslh ParamTree object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It includes function prototypes for managing parameter objects, getting and setting parameter values, and related operations in the context of the CCSP Cosa framework.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoReset
methods.description: Resets the parameter tree state.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetChildObjNames
methods.description: Retrieves names of child objects under a given parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetParamNames
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names for a given parameter path.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetParamValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoSetParamValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified parameter with detailed session and write ID handling.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoSetParamValueString
methods.description: Sets the string value of a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoSetParamValueInt
methods.description: Sets an integer value for a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoSetParamValueUint
methods.description: Sets an unsigned integer value for a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoSetParamValueBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean value for a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetParamInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a parameter, including access rights, type, value, and attributes.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetParamInfoShort
methods.description: Retrieves brief info about a parameter, including name, type, and value.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetHiddenInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hidden (restricted) parameter info.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetObjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about addable and deletable objects under a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoGetParamTypeAndValue
methods.description: Provides type and value details of a parameter.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoApplyChanges
methods.description: Applies pending changes to parameters.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoAddObject
methods.description: Adds a new object under a given parameter node.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoDelObject
methods.description: Deletes a specified object.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoAcqWriteAccess
methods.description: Acquires write access with a specified priority.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoRelWriteAccess
methods.description: Releases write access.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoIsParamTreeReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the parameter tree is read-only.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoIsParameterReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if a parameter is read-only.

methods.name: SlapDslhParamtoEscapeXmlString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for XML.
